name: Local Deep Researcher
description: Fully local web research assistant that loops search, summarise and reflect using a model served by Ollama or LM Studio.
whatItDoes: Given a topic it writes a markdown summary with the sources it used. It is meant for people who want iterative web research without sending prompts to a hosted LLM.
howItWorks: A LangGraph graph generates a search query, fetches results, summarises them, reflects on what is still missing, writes a follow-up query and repeats for a configured number of cycles. The LLM is a local model behind Ollama or LM Studio; search goes through a configurable SEARCH_API such as Tavily or Perplexity. It is driven from LangGraph Studio via the LangGraph dev server.

requirements.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
requirements.description: Needed when Tavily is the search backend

requirements.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
requirements.description: Needed when Perplexity is the search backend

models: Any model served by Ollama or LM Studio
